description: This Java source file defines the AsmAnalyzer class which is responsible for analyzing Java ARchive (JAR) files to extract class information using the ASM library. It includes methods to parse input JARs, convert class reader data to class names, and filter classes based on specific criteria.

classes.name: AsmAnalyzer
classes.description: A utility class for analyzing JAR files to extract class information and filter classes based on custom criteria.

methods.name: parseInputJar
methods.description: Parses a given JAR file and returns a map from class names to ASM ClassReader objects representing each class found.

methods.name: classReaderToAsmName
methods.description: Converts a ClassReader object into its fully qualified ASM class name.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters a map of classes in-place based on the provided filter criteria, removing classes that are not accepted.
